changelog: IMPORTANT: An app update is required to continue using VEXORA.
Added Spaces to share movies and shows with friends in real time.
Created profile creation with display names for a personalized experience.
Added quick access codes and links to easily invite friends.
Added badges to see who added each movie to a Space.
Fixed visual bugs with celebration animations.

features.title: What's New
items: Spaces: Create shared rooms to collect and watch movies and series together with friends.
Profiles: Pick a display name so your friends know who you are in shared spaces.
Easy Invites: Join spaces instantly using simple codes or direct links.
Member Badges: See who added each item to your shared space.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Cleaner layout and smoother navigation controls in Spaces.

features.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed animation glitches when clearing items.
